entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sheesh, everything I see is just[n]election this and election that.[n]Is this some kinda festival?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: The candidates are working[n]extra hard. After all, voting[n]does take place tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Did that bastard just blow[n]the whole thing off?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Do you think we should cut[n]into another TV broadcast?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hold on. We need to refrain from[n]making ourselves stand out.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I agree. We don't wanna stick[n]out too much right now.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: He'll likely give some kind of[n]speech after the election.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Assuming it's after the results[n]come in, tomorrow night.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I can only hope he actually[n]confesses his crimes...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Our job's finished. All we can do now is[n]sit back and watch.
